input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

bin_level_matrix_analysis_options.title: Bin-level matrix analysis options
bin_level_matrix_analysis_options.description: Parameters controlling bin-level matrix analysis and quality control.

bin_analysis_bin_size.description: Space Ranger binned output label used for bin-level matrix analysis.
bin_analysis_bin_size.help_text: For Visium HD data this is typically one of square_002um, square_008um, or square_016um.

bin_analysis_min_counts.description: Minimum total counts threshold for bin-level quality control.

bin_analysis_min_genes.description: Minimum detected genes threshold for bin-level quality control.

bin_analysis_max_mt.description: Maximum mitochondrial counts percentage threshold for bin-level quality control.

spatial_gene_key.description: Column in the spatial AnnData var containing gene identifiers used to match external datasets.
spatial_gene_key.help_text: Use 'var_names' when gene identifiers are stored in the spatial table var_names index.

single_cell_reference_options.title: Single-cell reference options
single_cell_reference_options.description: Single-cell reference data and annotations available to downstream analyses.

single_cell_reference_h5ad.description: Path to the single-cell reference AnnData file.
single_cell_reference_h5ad.help_text: The AnnData object must contain raw expression counts and a cell-type annotation in obs. It can be reused by downstream analyses that require a single-cell reference.
single_cell_reference_h5ad.errorMessage: The single-cell reference must be an existing .h5ad file whose path does not contain spaces.

single_cell_reference_cell_type_key.description: Column in the reference AnnData obs containing cell-type annotations.

single_cell_reference_batch_key.description: Column in the reference AnnData obs containing batch annotations.
single_cell_reference_batch_key.help_text: Set this parameter to 'none' when batch annotations are not available or should not be used.

single_cell_reference_counts_layer.description: Layer in the reference AnnData containing raw expression counts.
single_cell_reference_counts_layer.help_text: Set this parameter to 'X' when raw counts are stored in reference.X.

single_cell_reference_gene_key.description: Column in the reference AnnData var containing gene identifiers.
single_cell_reference_gene_key.help_text: Use 'var_names' when the gene identifiers are stored in reference.var_names.

cell2location_options.title: Cell2location result options
cell2location_options.description: Parameters controlling Cell2location result summaries and plots.

cell2location_abundance_statistic.description: Posterior point estimate used for abundance, fraction and composition outputs.
cell2location_abundance_statistic.help_text: Use 'mean' for quantitative abundance estimates or 'q05' for a conservative estimate of confidently present cells.

cell2location_uncertainty_min_abundance.description: Minimum posterior mean abundance included in relative posterior uncertainty maps.
cell2location_uncertainty_min_abundance.help_text: Locations at or below this value are masked to prevent unstable ratios when calculating (q95 - q05) / mean.

cell2location_multiqc_cell_types.description: Optional comma-separated list of up to three cell types for the compact per-sample deconvolution panel.
cell2location_multiqc_cell_types.help_text: Leave unset to select the three cell types with the highest whole-slide abundance independently for each sample.

cell_segmentation_options.title: Cell segmentation options
cell_segmentation_options.description: Parameters controlling cell segmentation and microscopy coordinate handling.

skip_segmentation.description: Skip microscopy image conversion, cell segmentation, and segmentation visualization outputs.
skip_segmentation.help_text: Use this option when microscopy images are present in the samplesheet but cell segmentation and the related MultiQC plots/statistics should not be generated.

segmentation_method.description: Algorithm used to segment nuclei in the microscopy image.
segmentation_method.help_text: Cellpose is the default GPU-capable deep-learning backend. 'skimage_watershed' uses H&E colour deconvolution, thresholding and marker-controlled watershed and is suitable for fast CPU execution.

zarr_downsample_factor.description: Downsampling factor between full-resolution TIFF image coordinates and the SpatialData zarr coordinate system.
zarr_downsample_factor.help_text: Use this parameter when the coordinates stored in the SpatialData zarr are downsampled relative to the full-resolution microscopy and segmentation TIFF images.

he_image_processing_options.title: H&E image editing and manipulation options
he_image_processing_options.description: Parameters controlling editing, cropping, and publication of H&E microscopy images.

capture_area_image_padding.description: Full-resolution pixels added around each side of the exported Visium capture-area image.
capture_area_image_padding.help_text: The padding is clamped to the microscopy image boundaries and does not alter the Visium bounds used for segmentation.

capture_area_image_downsample_factor.description: Factor by which both dimensions of the exported Visium capture-area image are reduced.
capture_area_image_downsample_factor.help_text: A value of 4 produces an image approximately one quarter as wide and one quarter as high. Use 1 to disable downsampling. Coordinates in the accompanying TSV remain relative to the full-resolution microscopy image.

save_capture_area_image.description: Publish the cropped high-resolution microscopy image and its coordinate TSV.
save_capture_area_image.help_text: Disable this option to keep the capture-area image and coordinate files out of the pipeline output directory.

bin_to_cell_mapping_options.title: Bin-to-cell mapping options
bin_to_cell_mapping_options.description: Parameters controlling Bin2Cell aggregation of spatial bins into cell-level data.

skip_bin2cell.description: Skip Bin2Cell aggregation of Visium HD bins into cell-level AnnData.
skip_bin2cell.help_text: Use this option when segmentation should be run but cell-level Bin2Cell aggregation should be skipped.

bin2cell_bin_size.description: Space Ranger binned output label used by Bin2Cell in bin aggregation.
bin2cell_bin_size.help_text: For Visium HD data this is typically one of square_002um, square_008um, or square_016um.

bin2cell_volume_ratio.description: Volume ratio used by Bin2Cell label expansion.
bin2cell_volume_ratio.help_text: Passed to bin2cell.expand_labels to expand nuclear segmentation labels before bin-to-cell aggregation.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` or `--spaceranger_index` are not specified. If you don't have a Space Ranger index available this will be generated for you automatically.

gtf.help_text: This parameter is mandatory if `--genome` or `--spaceranger_index` are not specified. If you don't have a Space Ranger index available this will be generated for you automatically.
gtf.errorMessage: The GTF file must have a .gtf or .gtf.gz extension, must not contain spaces, and must exist.

spaceranger_index.description: Path to a Space Ranger reference folder. Can alternatively be provided as `tar.gz` archive.
spaceranger_index.help_text: Please see the [10x website](https://support.10xgenomics.com/spatial-gene-expression/software/downloads/latest) to download either of the supported human or mouse references.

reference_name.description: Genome assembly label that will be used to name a new index built from fasta and gft files with spaceranger mkref.

probeset.description: Location of Space Ranger probeset file.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
